messages:
Ivy: quick QA on the new sparkline variant in the metrics panel. Two tiny UX pain points: axis label overflow on narrow cards and the smoothing toggle hides a millisecond spike. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/sparkline_bug.png
Noah: For narrow cards we should collapse the y-axis to a single compact label on the left and show a hover affordance to expand full ticks. Call it "compact axis" mode.
Samir: Compact axis sounds good. Rule: if card width < 220px, use compact axis: single primary tick + unit. Show full ticks in tooltip on hover or on focus.
Tess: Smoothing: current default is a 5-point spline. That obliterates 30-100ms blips. Add a "preserve-thresholds" mode where we smooth but keep raw markers for values that cross configured alert thresholds. Tooltip should say "visual smoothing only".
Ivy: Edgecase: numbers like 999.5 become 1.0k with current formatter. Propose: only apply SI suffix at >=1000. For decimals use max 2 significant digits (e.g., 1.23k). For values <1000 show full integer or one decimal if <1.
Noah: Also propose "tick hysteresis": dont flip from 4 to 5 ticks on tiny resizes. Keep tick count stable unless resize delta > 6%. Prevent noisy relayouts.
Samir: Legend behaviour: current inline legend wraps and pushes card height. New behaviour: collapse long legend into a chip list with a "more" caret that opens a popover. Keyboard: focus caret to open. Screen reader: announce "legend collapsed" when collapsed.
Tess: Accessibility nit: when smoothing toggles, update aria-live region with explanation: "Smoothing applied; raw outliers still marked". And ensure sentinel markers have accessible name "Outlier: {value} at {time}".
Ivy: Copy micro-nit: label the toggle "Line smoothing (visual only)" and tooltip expand "Preserves markers for points that trigger alerts". Keeps expectations clear.
Noah: Colorblind palette check: make sentinel halo >=3px contrast on both dark and light themes. Add contrast snapshot to PR.
Samir: Tests: visual regression for compact axis, hysteresis on resize, smoothing preserve-thresholds with sentinel overlay, legend collapse interactions and SR narration.
designbot: Created ticket https://design.redwood/tasks/CHART-3309  assignees: Tess, Samir, Noah  due: 5 days :calendar:
Ivy: I'll add the compact axis token and a tiny before/after gif in the PR.
Tess: I'll update strings.yml with the new toggle copy and prepare aria transcript.
Samir: I'll wire the hysteresis and add unit-format tests including 999 vs 1k case.
Noah: I'll generate contrast snapshots and attach to the PR.
Ivy: Thanks all, will follow up in task thread :thumbsup:
